name: Governance pack v0: a subset of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: A first governance pack: the AI RMF subcategories Shio can evidence from its own artefacts (agent cards, control proofs, signed records, evals, sign-offs). Framework choice to be confirmed by the founders (Credo AI ships this framework).
limits: Covers 11 of the AI RMF's subcategories, chosen because Shio's artefacts can evidence them. It says nothing about the organisational subcategories (culture, workforce, third-party contracts) that need policies and people rather than code. Requirement texts are Shio's paraphrase, not NIST's wording; subcategory references are to be checked by counsel.

frameworks.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1)

controls.title: Each AI system is inventoried with its intended purpose
controls.requirement: Every agent has a signed agent card stating its purpose, owner, audience, models, tools and data sources, reviewed by the named roles.

controls.title: Model output decides nothing without deterministic rules
controls.requirement: A model's output reaches an action or result only through checks and rules, and every acting tool call goes through the gate.

controls.title: Models are pinned to exact versions
controls.requirement: Every model the agent calls is pinned to an exact version or digest, so a change of model is a recorded change.

controls.title: Decisions are recorded, signed and tamper-evident
controls.requirement: Every decision is written as a signed record in a hash chain that shows any edit, deletion or reordering.

controls.title: Human oversight of outcomes
controls.requirement: The outcomes named as needing a person can't be decided without a sign-off by the named role, and those sign-offs happen.

controls.title: Validity and reliability are measured
controls.requirement: A regression suite runs in CI and its pass rate stays at or above the agreed level.

controls.title: Performance is compared across subgroups
controls.requirement: The largest gap in pass rate between subgroups stays under the agreed limit.

controls.title: Adversarial robustness is tested
controls.requirement: Red-team cases derived from each pack's adversarial fixtures all hold.

controls.title: Privacy risk is controlled for health data
controls.requirement: For agents handling health data, identifiers are removed from outputs (med.phi PHI-1).

controls.title: Third-party components are inventoried and pinned
controls.requirement: Every adapter is pinned to exact versions and an implementation hash, and every local module is hashed into each record.

controls.title: Post-deployment monitoring is reviewed
controls.requirement: Monitoring results (failure, override and drift rates, incidents) are reviewed and signed off by the governance reviewer.
